title: Tasks
steps: Open Chores. Tasks are checkboxes, with their tokens as chips where they're written: when they're due, how they repeat, priority, people and tags. Done tasks are muted and struck through.
Move the cursor onto a chip (w and e, or click beside it): that token shows its raw markdown, `due:2026-…`, so you edit real text. The rest of the line stays where it was.
Click Book a dentist appointment's checkbox: it's ticked, with done: and today's date, and the cursor stays where it was. Click again to reopen it.
Click Water the plants' checkbox: it shows ticked for a moment, then stays open with its due date moved on 3 days, on the same line.
Show history of this note: that change reads "Completed 'Water the plants' (due …)", by you.
⌘⇧P, Show tasks: Today, then every other open task, with the same checkboxes and chips.
